name: warn-act-notices
what_it_holds: Normalized US WARN Act mass-layoff/plant-closure notice archive, 1988-present, 61,309+ records as of 13 Sep 2026, covering 48 states (excludes AR, NH, WY which don't publish company-level notices). CSV and JSON, per-state files under data/by-state/, plus monthly/yearly time-series, employer rollups, RSS/ics calendar exports. Fields: employer name, canonical normalized employer name, location, employees affected, notice date, effective date, notice type (layoff/closure), state. Auto-updated daily (15 consecutive daily commits Aug30-Sep13 2026 observed). Built on Apache-2.0 biglocalnews/warn-scraper (Stanford Big Local News) as the underlying collector; this repo's own data is CC BY 4.0.
why_useful: Direct, company-name-searchable, point-in-time-stamped (daily commits) layoff-notice history that should contain Airbnb's California WARN filings from the 2020 mass layoff (~1,900 employees) and any later reductions — a real, dated headcount-shock signal (gap #14, corporate footprint) rather than a scraped estimate. Also usable as a macro/consumer-labor-market cross-check independent of ABNB.
license: CC BY 4.0 (data), Apache-2.0 (underlying scraper it builds on)
themes: Airbnb corporate footprint signals: careers/Greenhouse job-posting scrapers, LinkedIn headcount trackers, layoffs.fyi data, Glassdoor/Indeed review datasets, GitHub org activity (GH Archive)
why_all: Direct, company-name-searchable, point-in-time-stamped (daily commits) layoff-notice history that should contain Airbnb's California WARN filings from the 2020 mass layoff (~1,900 employees) and any later reductions — a real, dated headcount-shock signal (gap #14, corporate footprint) rather than a scraped estimate. Also usable as a macro/consumer-labor-market cross-check independent of ABNB.

name: vancouver-analysis
what_it_holds: Full bookdown report repo (00-executive_summary.Rmd ... 05-references.Rmd) plus a committed data/ folder: data/cmhc/ has CMHC annual rental-market-survey workbooks (annual_avg_rent_2015-2019.xlsx, annual_units_2015-2019.xlsx ~1.1MB each, annual_vacancy_2015-2019.xlsx ~1.5MB each, plus condensed van_avg_rent.csv, van_units.csv, van_vacancy.csv) by Vancouver neighbourhood; data/shapefiles/ has CMHC_NBHD_2016 neighbourhood boundary shapefile (16MB .shp), a Vancouver business-licences shapefile (85MB .dbf — city business licence registry, likely including STR operator licences), a local-area-boundary shapefile, and a rapid-transit-station point shapefile; plus a van_scrape.Rdata (Airbnb/STR scrape snapshot). Covers 'regulatory impacts' and 'COVID returning listings' analysis, 2015-2020ish.
why_useful: Committed CMHC rental vacancy/rent/unit-count tables by Vancouver neighbourhood (2015-2019) are exactly the free, public LTR housing-economics panel named in gap #13 (STR<->LTR crossover), and the business-licence shapefile is a real municipal STR-adjacent registry (gap #12) with geographic boundaries attached.
time_coverage: 2015-2020 (CMHC tables); business licence shapefile vintage unclear
size_hint: ~227 MB repo (dominated by the 85MB business-licences.dbf and 16MB neighbourhood shapefile)
themes: UPGo (McGill) and strr R package: STR research tooling and datasets for Canada/US cities
why_all: Committed CMHC rental vacancy/rent/unit-count tables by Vancouver neighbourhood (2015-2019) are exactly the free, public LTR housing-economics panel named in gap #13 (STR<->LTR crossover), and the business-licence shapefile is a real municipal STR-adjacent registry (gap #12) with geographic boundaries attached.

name: AsunaMasuda/Tokyo_Airbnb
